Use the OpenAI Decisions API

Source: R/deciders.R
decider_openai.Rd

Makes a decider for a model of the OpenAI Decisions API (https://api.openai.com).

Usage

decider_openai(model = NULL, credentials = NULL, input = NULL)

Arguments

model

The model name. NULL (the default) uses "gpt-6-luna" and prints a message that names it.

credentials

A function with no arguments that returns the key. NULL (the default) reads the environment variable OPENAI_API_KEY each time decide() sends requests.

input

The input type that the model reads: "text", "image" or "text+image". NULL (the default) takes it from the internal table of input types; a model that is not in the table is not checked. decide() stops before any request when an input does not fit.

Value

A decider object for decide(). It holds no key.

Details

OpenAI does not report a cost, so .cost is NA in the output of decide().

Examples

decider_openai("gpt-6-luna")
#> <decider> OpenAI
#> * Model: gpt-6-luna
#> * URL: https://api.openai.com/v1/decisions
#> * Request format: openai
#> * Input: text+image
